text: The file could not be written. Either another program is using it right now (editor, spreadsheet program, virus scanner, sync service; on Windows usually the reason), or it is write-protected or your user account may not change it. Close other programs, check the write protection and permissions, and choose “Save” again: the interrupted merge is then continued and nothing is lost. If that does not help, ask whoever looks after the computer.
